senses.en_definition: Sorcery or witchcraft believed to involve spirits or other supernatural powers; magic in fantasy.

messages.en: The wizard in that film is insanely powerful. He can even smash through a stone door.
Right? At first I thought he was going to help, but it turns out he's the villain.
Same here! No wonder everyone's scared of him.

senses.en_definition: A small amount; a little; slightly when modifying an action.

messages.en: I'm at the shop now. Where are you?
Hang on a bit, okay? I'm looking for a parking spot. I'll be there in about five minutes.
Okay, I'll wait inside. Want me to order you a drink first?

senses.en_definition: Please; used to introduce a polite invitation or request.
A sitting position with the legs bent and crossed.
Moral conduct; behaviour in accordance with accepted rules and standards of propriety.

messages.en: I'm outside your house now. Is the door unlocked?
Yeah, come on in. I'm in the kitchen frying chicken.
Okay, I'm coming in. I can smell the chicken all the way out here!

senses.en_definition: Please; go ahead; used to politely invite someone to enter, sit down, or do something.

messages.en: I'm outside your house now. Can I come straight in?
Come on in, the door's unlocked. Make yourself comfortable on the sofa. I'm making some drinks.
Okay, I'm coming in. Don't go to any trouble. Plain water is fine.
